03 / APPROACH

From unclear process
to working system.

A practical loop for building portfolio-grade systems and client-ready prototypes without disappearing into unnecessary complexity.

  1. 01

    Find the leverage point

    Map the current process, the repeated pain, the people involved, and the outcome worth improving.

    DIAGNOSE
  2. 02

    Build the smallest useful flow

    Connect only the inputs, decisions, and actions needed to prove value with real examples.

    PROTOTYPE
  3. 03

    Test the failure paths

    Check bad inputs, uncertainty, duplicate actions, handoff points, cost, and maintainability.

    VALIDATE
  4. 04

    Ship the result clearly

    Package the build, document the decisions, measure the outcome, and turn it into a useful case study.

    DELIVER
04 / ABOUT

I’m Alborz Seifaei—an applied AI builder focused on the overlap between automation, intelligent products, and the physical world.

My work started from a real domain problem: monitoring and optimizing controlled growing environments. That pushed me beyond “just code” toward the complete system—data, models, hardware constraints, operator decisions, and measurable outcomes.

Today I’m building three flagship projects to develop the skills that matter in practice: identifying the bottleneck, designing the workflow, shipping a prototype, and communicating its value clearly.
